summary: TyreBook frontend-only regression pass for iteration_5 fixes (localId helper + hardened admin guards). All 8 review checkpoints PASS on mobile 390x844. (A1) /admin/vehicles seeder renders with 0 'same key' console warnings. (A2) Adding 3 vehicle rows in rapid succession produced 0 dup-key warnings. (B4) Direct navigation to /admin from a fresh logged-out session (localStorage cleared) renders an empty body (length 0 — the `if (!user) return null` guard fires) and never shows admin tiles. (B5) Logged in as staff, all four admin routes (/admin, /admin/pricing, /admin/vehicles, /admin/app-settings) redirect to /settings (final URL check passes for each). (D8) Admin hub shows all 13 expected tiles (dashboard, reports, master, inventory, pricing, vehicles, customers, suppliers, users, shop, ai, settings, backup) plus owner-badge + admin-kpi-strip + admin-bottom-nav. Verified `grep local-\${Date.now()}` returns zero matches across src/ and app/, and all 8 firebase mocks (inventory/sales/master/khata/users/vehicles/stock/purchase) import localId from src/utils/localId.ts. No deprecated Expo packages detected in files changed this iteration.
